newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says not exposed to Pocket Inc.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says not exposed to Pocket Inc.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Wednesday it was not financially exposed to U.S. Pocket Communications Inc., a wireless personal communications services (PCS) operator.
Pocket voluntarily sought bankruptcy protection earlier this week, after defaulting on $80 million in loans, to satisfy short-term financing requirements and to initiate a restructuring plan.
"We are not financially exposed to Pocket and won't lose any money if it goes bankrupt," Ericsson spokesman Per Bengtsson told Reuters.
"We have not put any orders in our order books, so an eventual bankruptcy would not affect our order intake for 1996, for example."
Bengtsson said rumours that total project financing in Pocket amounted to more than $1 billion were false.
"Total project financing in Pocket amounts to $646 million," he said.
"Of that, $481 million is related to Ericsson and Nortel (Northern Telecom Ltd) and of the $481 million more than half is Ericsson's.
"But you have to remember that the financing is connected to deliveries and we haven't delivered anything so no money has been booked on our side."
